QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_39

question.text: The Annual Statutory Reporting by a Cat III AIF typically includes all of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Consolidated PPM/fund-document changes (intimated within 1 month of FYE)
Daily trade blotter for every trade executed

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 13.3 lists fund valuation/performance, Stewardship discharge, and consolidated PPM changes as annual statutory reporting content. Daily trade blotter (D) is not a component of annual statutory reporting — that's internal/audit material. **The Trap:** Options A, B, C are verbatim in the PDF. Option D is internal ops material. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C/D test the same annual-reporting composition. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Trade blotters ARE reviewed by auditors and the compliance officer, but are not disseminated to LPs in annual reports — only aggregated exposure and attribution go to LPs.
